in_marathi.name: Rudranath
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rudranath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rudra, the deity of the primal force of nature, is the god of rudimentary, raw energy. The name Rudranath means 'Lord of Rudra'. It is a name of reverence and fear, and invokes the power of Shiva, the destroyer and transformer.
